an5.304:1.1: “Bhikkhus, for direct knowledge of lust, five things are to be developed.
an5.304:1.3: The perception of impermanence, the perception of non-self, the perception of death, the perception of the repulsiveness of food, and the perception of non-delight in the entire world.
an5.304:1.4: For direct knowledge of lust, these five things are to be developed.”
